svg.aria-label: LUCI system architecture: content sources (satellite, cable TV, internet, local A/V, music) feed into LUCI. LUCI is the control point — the orchestration platform running on one standardized rack of components, operated from any browser or interface. From there LUCI controls the A/V across the property — displays, digital signage, video walls, lighting, and background music and paging — over your existing network.
